output: Thanks for laying out the entity setup, because it matters for the answer. The product consolidates entities for planning and management reporting, including currency translation and standard intercompany eliminations. It is not built for statutory consolidation, and it does not handle partial ownership, minority interest or several accounting standards. So for your two entities reporting under a different standard, I would recommend keeping your current close and consolidation tool for statutory reporting and loading its consolidated actuals into planning. As proof of how this works, [PLACEHOLDER] customer story: group plans in the product and loads actuals from its existing close tool. If you want to go further, I would suggest a proof of concept on your real entity structure before any commitment. The next step I'd offer is a working session with a solutions consultant to map your entity structure and agree which parts stay in the close tool and which move to planning.
